function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

The function signature expects companies: string[] and duration: string. But the user wants multiple durations for each company. The function only accepts one duration. We need to interpret the request. The user wants to retrieve stock prices for each company for each duration. That means we need to call the function multiple times, once per duration.
